_note: Pure-Python wheels the chapter 15 page embeds (template 9.44.0 unpacks them in the page's Python worker) so that ezsheets and the real google-api-python-client can run in the browser; Pyodide 0.28.2's own distribution has neither, but it does have the packages named in pyodide_packages, which the page loads first. Downloaded from PyPI with pip on 2026-10-12; the page-data builder refuses a file whose SHA-256 differs from the one recorded here. The wheels build requests and read answers; no example reaches Google. ezsheets is licensed GPL-3.0-or-later; the page embeds it unmodified together with its source distribution committed in 03-materials/ch15/assets. boot_python skips the docstring text that google-api-python-client builds for each method of each resource (Schemas.prettyPrintSchema and Schemas.prettyPrintByName return an empty string) (no request, answer or argument depends on it; it makes each example several times faster in the browser). It also defines _before_run(), which the Python worker calls before every program (template 9.44.0) and which puts ezsheets, the clock functions and the working folder back as they were at start, because the browser keeps one Python for many programs where the study ran a fresh interpreter for each.

import googleapiclient.schema as _s
_s.Schemas.prettyPrintSchema = lambda self, schema: ''
_s.Schemas.prettyPrintByName = lambda self, name: ''  # skips the docstring that google-api-python-client writes for every method of every resource it builds; it only makes help() text, and it takes seconds in the browser
import os, sys, time, ezsheets
_cwd0, _sleep0, _time0, _ez0 = os.getcwd(), time.sleep, time.time, dict(vars(ezsheets))
def _before_run():
    # the browser keeps one Python for many programs, a fresh interpreter per program is what the study ran: put ezsheets, the clock and the folder back as they were at start
    os.chdir(_cwd0); time.sleep = _sleep0; time.time = _time0
    sys.modules['ezsheets'] = ezsheets
    for k in [k for k in vars(ezsheets) if k not in _ez0]: delattr(ezsheets, k)
    vars(ezsheets).update(_ez0)
    ezsheets._WRITE_REQUESTS.clear(); ezsheets._READ_REQUESTS.clear()
